title: The Comprehensive List of RAG and Retrieval Tools

tools.name: LangChain
tools.description: LangChain is an application framework with retriever abstractions, document loaders, vector-store integrations, retrieval chains, and middleware for building RAG and agent workflows in Python and JavaScript.

tools.name: LlamaIndex
tools.description: LlamaIndex is a data framework for context-augmented applications with indexes, retrievers, query engines, data connectors, agents, and managed services available through LlamaCloud.

tools.name: Haystack
tools.description: Haystack is deepset's component-based framework for production search and RAG pipelines, with typed components for conversion, preprocessing, embedding, retrieval, ranking, routing, and generation.

tools.name: DSPy
tools.description: DSPy is a framework for programming and optimizing language-model systems whose retrieval modules and optimizers can tune multi-stage RAG pipelines against an objective.

tools.name: txtai
tools.description: txtai is an all-in-one embeddings database and semantic-workflow framework that combines vector search, SQL, graph traversal, topic modeling, extractive QA, and RAG pipelines.

tools.name: R2R
tools.description: R2R is an open-source retrieval system and API for multimodal ingestion, hybrid search, knowledge graphs, agents, and RAG, paired with hosted and enterprise offerings.

tools.name: RAGFlow
tools.description: RAGFlow is an open-source RAG engine with document understanding, template-based chunking, hybrid retrieval, agent workflows, and a commercial cloud service.

tools.name: Pathway
tools.description: Pathway is a Python data-processing framework for live, incremental pipelines that supports continuously updated RAG indexes, document parsing, vector search, and streaming connectors.

tools.name: LangGraph
tools.description: LangGraph is a low-level orchestration framework for stateful agents whose graphs can implement iterative retrieval, query routing, corrective RAG, and human review.

tools.name: Semantic Kernel
tools.description: Semantic Kernel is Microsoft's SDK for composing models, plugins, memory, vector stores, and process orchestration in C#, Python, and Java applications.

tools.name: Spring AI
tools.description: Spring AI is a Spring-ecosystem application framework with portable model, embedding, vector-store, document-reader, text-splitter, advisor, and retrieval-augmentation APIs.

tools.name: Langroid
tools.description: Langroid is a multi-agent LLM framework whose document-chat agents provide parsing, chunking, vector storage, relevance extraction, citations, and conversational RAG.

tools.name: Quivr
tools.description: Quivr is an opinionated RAG framework for integrating ingestion, retrieval, generation, and configurable workflows into applications through Python and API interfaces.

tools.name: RAGLite
tools.description: RAGLite is a compact Python toolkit for PostgreSQL-based RAG with document ingestion, hybrid retrieval, reranking, prompt assembly, and evaluation-oriented metadata.

tools.name: FlashRAG
tools.description: FlashRAG is a research toolkit that implements multiple RAG methods, datasets, retrieval backends, generators, and evaluation workflows behind a common Python interface.

tools.name: Embedchain
tools.description: Embedchain is an open-source RAG framework that loads, chunks, embeds, indexes, and synchronizes unstructured data for question answering and personalized AI applications.

tools.name: Pinecone
tools.category: Vector Databases and Vector Search Libraries
tools.description: Pinecone is a managed vector database with dense and sparse indexes, metadata filtering, namespaces, hybrid retrieval, integrated inference, and serverless deployment options.

tools.name: Weaviate
tools.category: Vector Databases and Vector Search Libraries
tools.description: Weaviate is an open-source vector database with managed cloud offerings, supporting vector, keyword, and hybrid search, filters, multi-tenancy, replication, and pluggable vectorizers.

tools.name: Qdrant
tools.category: Vector Databases and Vector Search Libraries
tools.description: Qdrant is an open-source vector search engine with payload filtering, dense and sparse vectors, hybrid queries, quantization, distributed deployment, and a managed cloud.

tools.name: Milvus
tools.category: Vector Databases and Vector Search Libraries
tools.description: Milvus is a distributed open-source vector database with multiple ANN index types, scalar filtering, hybrid search, GPU support, and horizontal scaling.

tools.name: Zilliz Cloud
tools.category: Vector Databases and Vector Search Libraries
tools.description: Zilliz Cloud is the managed Milvus service, adding serverless and dedicated clusters, operational automation, backup, security controls, and integrated data and model services.

tools.name: Chroma
tools.category: Vector Databases and Vector Search Libraries
tools.description: Chroma is an open-source AI data store with collection, embedding, filtering, and vector-query APIs, plus a managed Chroma Cloud service.

tools.name: pgvector
tools.category: Vector Databases and Vector Search Libraries
tools.description: pgvector is a PostgreSQL extension that adds exact and approximate vector similarity search, HNSW and IVFFlat indexes, multiple distance functions, and SQL-native filtering.

tools.name: LanceDB
tools.category: Vector Databases and Vector Search Libraries
tools.description: LanceDB is an open-source, embedded multimodal database built on the Lance columnar format, with vector, full-text, and hybrid search plus a managed cloud.

tools.name: FAISS
tools.category: Vector Databases and Vector Search Libraries
tools.description: FAISS is Meta's library for efficient similarity search and clustering of dense vectors, offering CPU and GPU implementations and a broad family of exact and ANN indexes.

tools.name: Vespa
tools.category: Vector Databases and Vector Search Libraries
tools.description: Vespa is an open-source serving engine that combines structured filtering, lexical matching, nearest-neighbor search, configurable ranking expressions, and distributed document storage.

tools.name: Elasticsearch
tools.category: Vector Databases and Vector Search Libraries
tools.description: Elasticsearch is a distributed search and analytics engine with full-text, dense-vector, sparse-vector, hybrid retrieval, filtering, and learned-reranking capabilities.

tools.name: OpenSearch
tools.category: Vector Databases and Vector Search Libraries
tools.description: OpenSearch is an Apache-2.0 search and analytics suite with k-NN vector indexes, neural and hybrid search pipelines, full-text retrieval, filters, and plugins.

tools.name: Redis Vector Search
tools.category: Vector Databases and Vector Search Libraries
tools.description: Redis Vector Search is Redis's query capability for HNSW or flat vector indexes combined with metadata, numeric, geospatial, and full-text filters.

tools.name: MongoDB Atlas Vector Search
tools.category: Vector Databases and Vector Search Libraries
tools.description: MongoDB Atlas Vector Search is a managed capability for ANN and exact vector search over Atlas documents, with prefilters and hybrid search through aggregation pipelines.

tools.name: Supabase Vector
tools.category: Vector Databases and Vector Search Libraries
tools.description: Supabase Vector is Supabase's PostgreSQL-based toolkit for storing embeddings with pgvector, generating them through Edge Functions, and combining retrieval with relational data and authorization.

tools.name: sqlite-vec
tools.category: Vector Databases and Vector Search Libraries
tools.description: sqlite-vec is a compact SQLite extension for storing and querying float, int8, and binary vectors without a separate database server.

tools.name: USearch
tools.category: Vector Databases and Vector Search Libraries
tools.description: USearch is a single-file vector-search library with HNSW indexes, multiple scalar and binary types, user-defined metrics, persistence, and bindings for several languages.

tools.name: Annoy
tools.category: Vector Databases and Vector Search Libraries
tools.description: Annoy is Spotify's read-optimized approximate-nearest-neighbor library using memory-mapped forests of random-projection trees for static vector collections.

tools.name: ScaNN
tools.category: Vector Databases and Vector Search Libraries
tools.description: ScaNN is Google's vector-similarity search library using quantization, partitioning, and score-aware algorithms for efficient maximum inner-product and nearest-neighbor search.

tools.name: hnswlib
tools.category: Vector Databases and Vector Search Libraries
tools.description: hnswlib is a lightweight C++ and Python implementation of Hierarchical Navigable Small World graphs for approximate nearest-neighbor search with incremental updates.

tools.name: Marqo
tools.category: Vector Databases and Vector Search Libraries
tools.description: Marqo is an open-source tensor-search engine for text and images with embedding inference, lexical-vector hybrid search, filtering, reranking, and a managed cloud.

tools.name: TiDB Vector Search
tools.category: Vector Databases and Vector Search Libraries
tools.description: TiDB Vector Search adds vector columns, distance functions, and HNSW indexes to the distributed SQL database so transactional data and embeddings can be queried together.

tools.name: ClickHouse Vector Search
tools.category: Vector Databases and Vector Search Libraries
tools.description: ClickHouse Vector Search uses vector distance functions and approximate vector-similarity indexes alongside columnar analytics and SQL filtering.

tools.name: turbopuffer
tools.category: Vector Databases and Vector Search Libraries
tools.description: turbopuffer is a managed search engine that stores vector and full-text indexes on object storage and exposes filtering, namespaces, and multi-query APIs.

tools.name: Moss
tools.category: Vector Databases and Vector Search Libraries
tools.description: Moss is a retrieval SDK that loads cloud-managed indexes into application memory for local semantic, keyword, and hybrid queries.

tools.name: Apache Lucene
tools.description: Apache Lucene is the Java search library underlying many search platforms, with inverted indexes, BM25 ranking, faceting, filters, query parsing, and vector search.

tools.name: Apache Solr
tools.description: Apache Solr is a distributed search server built on Lucene with full-text retrieval, faceting, replication, streaming expressions, learning-to-rank, and dense-vector search.

tools.name: Meilisearch
tools.description: Meilisearch is an open-source search engine with typo tolerance, filters, facets, semantic embeddings, and hybrid ranking, paired with a managed cloud.

tools.name: Typesense
tools.description: Typesense is a typo-tolerant search engine with faceting, filtering, vector search, conversational search, and hybrid rank fusion, plus a hosted service.

tools.name: Tantivy
tools.description: Tantivy is a Rust full-text search library inspired by Lucene, providing inverted indexes, BM25, facets, range queries, and incremental indexing.

tools.name: Xapian
tools.description: Xapian is a portable C++ search library with probabilistic ranking, relevance feedback, phrase and boolean queries, spelling correction, and bindings for multiple languages.

tools.name: Whoosh
tools.description: Whoosh is a pure-Python full-text indexing and search library retained as a lightweight reference implementation for schemas, query parsing, and BM25F-style scoring.

tools.name: Pyserini
tools.description: Pyserini is Castorini's Python toolkit for reproducible sparse, dense, and hybrid retrieval experiments over Lucene indexes and standard IR test collections.

tools.name: Anserini
tools.description: Anserini is Castorini's Java IR toolkit built on Lucene for indexing, BM25 retrieval, impact scoring, evaluation, and reproducible research baselines.

tools.name: BM25S
tools.description: BM25S is a Python library that implements BM25 variants with sparse matrices for fast local indexing and retrieval, including persistence and Hugging Face integrations.

tools.name: ParadeDB
tools.description: ParadeDB is a PostgreSQL search extension and platform that brings BM25, full-text, filtering, analytics, and hybrid search into SQL workloads.

tools.name: Azure AI Search
tools.category: Managed Retrieval APIs and Knowledge Bases
tools.description: Azure AI Search is Microsoft's managed search service for full-text, vector, hybrid, semantic-ranker, filtering, enrichment, and integrated vectorization workloads.

tools.name: Vertex AI Vector Search
tools.category: Managed Retrieval APIs and Knowledge Bases
tools.description: Vertex AI Vector Search is Google Cloud's managed ANN service for dense, sparse, and hybrid retrieval with filtering, autoscaling, and streaming or batch updates.

tools.name: Vertex AI RAG Engine
tools.category: Managed Retrieval APIs and Knowledge Bases
tools.description: Vertex AI RAG Engine is Google's managed RAG data service for corpus creation, ingestion, chunking, embedding, retrieval, and grounding with Vertex AI models.

tools.name: Amazon Kendra
tools.category: Managed Retrieval APIs and Knowledge Bases
tools.description: Amazon Kendra is an AWS enterprise search service with connectors, document enrichment, natural-language queries, relevance tuning, access controls, and semantic ranking.

tools.name: Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases
tools.category: Managed Retrieval APIs and Knowledge Bases
tools.description: Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases is a managed RAG service that ingests data sources, creates vector or graph-backed indexes, retrieves evidence, and can generate cited responses.

tools.name: Amazon OpenSearch Service
tools.category: Managed Retrieval APIs and Knowledge Bases
tools.description: Amazon OpenSearch Service is AWS's managed deployment of OpenSearch with full-text, vector, neural, and hybrid search plus serverless and provisioned operating modes.

tools.name: Databricks Mosaic AI Vector Search
tools.category: Managed Retrieval APIs and Knowledge Bases
tools.description: Databricks Mosaic AI Vector Search is a managed vector database integrated with Delta tables, Unity Catalog, embedding endpoints, filtering, hybrid search, and automatic index synchronization.

tools.name: OpenAI File Search
tools.category: Managed Retrieval APIs and Knowledge Bases
tools.description: OpenAI File Search is a hosted Responses API tool that searches uploaded vector stores with semantic and keyword retrieval before supplying results to a model.

tools.name: Vectara
tools.category: Managed Retrieval APIs and Knowledge Bases
tools.description: Vectara is a managed RAG platform with document ingestion, multilingual retrieval, hybrid search, reranking, grounded generation, citations, and factual-consistency scoring.

tools.name: Ragie
tools.category: Managed Retrieval APIs and Knowledge Bases
tools.description: Ragie is a managed RAG-as-a-service platform for source connectors, document parsing, partitioning, indexing, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and permission-aware results.

tools.name: Nuclia
tools.category: Managed Retrieval APIs and Knowledge Bases
tools.description: Nuclia is a retrieval platform with an open-source database component and managed APIs for ingestion, multimodal extraction, vector and keyword search, agents, and RAG.

tools.name: Contextual AI
tools.category: Managed Retrieval APIs and Knowledge Bases
tools.description: Contextual AI is a managed enterprise RAG platform with data ingestion, retrieval, reranking, grounded generation, evaluations, and deployment controls.

tools.name: Cloudflare AutoRAG
tools.category: Managed Retrieval APIs and Knowledge Bases
tools.description: Cloudflare AutoRAG is a managed pipeline that monitors data sources, parses and chunks content, creates embeddings, indexes it in Vectorize, and exposes retrieval and generation APIs.

tools.name: Snowflake Cortex Search
tools.category: Managed Retrieval APIs and Knowledge Bases
tools.description: Snowflake Cortex Search is a managed hybrid search service over Snowflake data with automated embedding, refresh, filtering, and low-latency query APIs.

tools.name: IBM watsonx Discovery
tools.category: Managed Retrieval APIs and Knowledge Bases
tools.description: IBM watsonx Discovery is an enterprise document-understanding and search service with connectors, enrichment, passage retrieval, natural-language queries, and access-control support.

tools.name: OpenAI Embeddings
tools.description: OpenAI Embeddings is a hosted API for the text-embedding model family, with configurable dimensions on current models and support for search, clustering, and recommendation workloads.

tools.name: Cohere Embed
tools.description: Cohere Embed is a hosted multilingual embedding model family with separate query and document input types and support for text and multimodal document representations.

tools.name: Jina Embeddings
tools.description: Jina Embeddings is Jina AI's downloadable multilingual embedding model family, with task-specific adapters and long-context support under model-specific licenses.

tools.name: Voyage AI Embeddings
tools.description: Voyage AI Embeddings is a hosted model family for general, multilingual, code, finance, legal, and multimodal retrieval through an embedding API.

tools.name: BGE
tools.description: BGE is BAAI's family of dense, sparse, multilingual, and instruction-aware retrieval models distributed with the FlagEmbedding training and inference library.

tools.name: E5
tools.description: E5 is Microsoft's text-embedding model family trained with contrastive objectives and query-passage prefixes for retrieval, clustering, classification, and semantic similarity.

tools.name: Nomic Embed
tools.description: Nomic Embed is Nomic AI's downloadable text-embedding model family with task prefixes, long context, and Matryoshka dimensions for adjustable storage and latency.

tools.name: Sentence Transformers
tools.description: Sentence Transformers is a Python library for training and serving bi-encoder embeddings, sparse encoders, and cross-encoder rerankers from local or hosted models.

tools.name: INSTRUCTOR
tools.description: INSTRUCTOR is an instruction-tuned embedding model family that conditions representations on a natural-language task description for retrieval and other embedding tasks.

tools.name: GTE
tools.description: GTE is Alibaba's general text-embedding model family for retrieval and semantic similarity, with multilingual, long-context, sparse, and newer instruction-tuned variants.

tools.name: Snowflake Arctic Embed
tools.description: Snowflake Arctic Embed is a downloadable embedding model family optimized for retrieval, with multilingual versions and Matryoshka representation support.

tools.name: Mixedbread Embed
tools.description: Mixedbread Embed is Mixedbread AI's downloadable embedding model family for semantic search and RAG, with Matryoshka dimensions and quantized representation options.

tools.name: Qwen3 Embedding
tools.description: Qwen3 Embedding is Qwen's downloadable multilingual embedding model family for text retrieval, code retrieval, classification, clustering, and semantic similarity.

tools.name: Vertex AI Text Embeddings
tools.description: Vertex AI Text Embeddings is Google Cloud's managed API for text and code embedding models with task types and configurable output dimensionality.

tools.name: Mistral Embed
tools.description: Mistral Embed is Mistral AI's hosted endpoint for producing text vectors used in semantic search, clustering, classification, and RAG applications.

tools.name: FastEmbed
tools.description: FastEmbed is Qdrant's lightweight Python library for local dense, sparse, late-interaction, and reranking inference using optimized model runtimes.

tools.name: Cohere Rerank
tools.description: Cohere Rerank is a hosted cross-encoder-style API that orders text or semi-structured documents by relevance to a query across multilingual and English model variants.

tools.name: Jina Reranker
tools.description: Jina Reranker is Jina AI's multilingual cross-encoder model family for query-document relevance scoring, available as downloadable weights and a hosted API.

tools.name: Voyage Rerank
tools.description: Voyage Rerank is a hosted relevance-scoring API that reranks candidate documents for a query with general-purpose and domain-oriented model options.

tools.name: BGE Reranker
tools.description: BGE Reranker is BAAI's downloadable cross-encoder and layerwise reranker family for multilingual query-passage scoring and retrieval refinement.

tools.name: ColBERT
tools.description: ColBERT is a neural retrieval system that encodes queries and documents independently but preserves token vectors for efficient late-interaction MaxSim scoring.

tools.name: RAGatouille
tools.description: RAGatouille is a Python library that simplifies training, indexing, and retrieval with ColBERT-style late-interaction models and integrations with common RAG frameworks.

tools.name: RankLLM
tools.description: RankLLM is a research toolkit for listwise and pairwise passage reranking with language models, including reproducible implementations of RankGPT-style methods.

tools.name: FlashRank
tools.description: FlashRank is a lightweight local reranking library that packages compact cross-encoder and listwise models for CPU-oriented RAG pipelines.

tools.name: Mixedbread Rerank
tools.description: Mixedbread Rerank is Mixedbread AI's downloadable multilingual cross-encoder model family for ordering text candidates by query relevance, with local and hosted inference options.

tools.name: Pinecone Rerank
tools.description: Pinecone Rerank is a managed inference endpoint that scores candidate documents against a query and can be used after Pinecone or external first-stage retrieval.

tools.name: Qwen3 Reranker
tools.description: Qwen3 Reranker is Qwen's downloadable multilingual relevance model family for text and code retrieval with instruction-aware query-document scoring.

tools.name: ZeroEntropy zerank
tools.description: ZeroEntropy zerank is a hosted reranking model and API for rescoring retrieved passages, with document search services available from the same provider.

tools.name: Unstructured
tools.description: Unstructured is an open-source library and commercial platform for partitioning, cleaning, staging, and chunking PDFs, office documents, HTML, emails, and images for downstream retrieval.

tools.name: Docling
tools.description: Docling is an open-source document conversion toolkit for PDF, office, HTML, image, audio, and structured formats, preserving layout, tables, reading order, and provenance.

tools.name: LlamaParse
tools.description: LlamaParse is LlamaIndex's managed document parser for PDFs and other files, producing structured text, Markdown, tables, images, layout metadata, and configurable parsing outputs.

tools.name: Apache Tika
tools.description: Apache Tika is a content-detection and extraction toolkit that reads text and metadata from more than a thousand file types through Java, server, and parser APIs.

tools.name: PyMuPDF
tools.description: PyMuPDF is a Python binding for MuPDF that extracts, searches, renders, and modifies PDFs and other documents, including text blocks, images, tables, and coordinates.

tools.name: pypdf
tools.description: pypdf is a pure-Python PDF library for reading, splitting, merging, transforming, and extracting text and metadata without external runtime dependencies.

tools.name: pdfplumber
tools.description: pdfplumber is a Python library for detailed PDF text, character, line, rectangle, and table extraction with access to page geometry.

tools.name: Marker
tools.description: Marker is an open-source document converter from Datalab that turns PDFs, images, presentations, and office files into Markdown, JSON, HTML, chunks, and structured blocks.

tools.name: MinerU
tools.description: MinerU is an open-source document parsing toolkit that converts complex PDFs into Markdown or JSON while handling formulas, tables, images, reading order, and OCR.

tools.name: MegaParse
tools.description: MegaParse is an open-source parser for PDF, DOCX, PPTX, spreadsheet, CSV, and text inputs, producing formats intended for LLM ingestion.

tools.name: Tesseract OCR
tools.description: Tesseract OCR is an open-source optical character recognition engine with command-line and library interfaces and trained language data for many writing systems.

tools.name: PaddleOCR
tools.description: PaddleOCR is an open-source OCR and document-AI toolkit with multilingual text recognition, layout analysis, table and formula recognition, and document parsing pipelines.

tools.name: Surya
tools.description: Surya is an open-source document OCR toolkit for multilingual text recognition, layout analysis, reading order, and table recognition.

tools.name: Chunkr
tools.description: Chunkr is an open-source document intelligence API with a separate managed service for layout analysis, OCR, structured output, and token-aware semantic chunking.

tools.name: Chonkie
tools.description: Chonkie is an open-source chunking and ingestion library with token, sentence, recursive, semantic, late, code, table, and model-assisted chunkers plus a cloud service.

tools.name: Firecrawl
tools.description: Firecrawl is an open-source crawling and extraction API with a managed service for search, site maps, browser rendering, structured extraction, and Markdown output.

tools.name: Crawl4AI
tools.description: Crawl4AI is an open-source asynchronous web crawler for LLM data pipelines with browser rendering, extraction strategies, adaptive crawling, filtering, and Markdown generation.

tools.name: Scrapy
tools.description: Scrapy is a mature Python framework for asynchronous crawling, request scheduling, link following, item extraction, middleware, throttling, and export pipelines.

tools.name: Trafilatura
tools.description: Trafilatura is a Python package and command-line tool for discovering, downloading, and extracting main text, metadata, comments, and structure from web pages.

tools.name: Jina Reader
tools.description: Jina Reader is a hosted URL-to-LLM-input API that fetches web pages and returns cleaned Markdown, with search and grounding endpoints in the same service family.

tools.name: Exa
tools.description: Exa is a hosted web search and content API offering neural and keyword retrieval, page contents, highlights, crawling, and research-oriented endpoints.

tools.name: Tavily
tools.description: Tavily is a hosted search, extract, crawl, and map API designed to return web evidence and structured results to AI applications.

tools.name: Apify
tools.description: Apify is a cloud platform for web scraping and browser automation built around reusable Actors, datasets, schedules, proxies, and open-source crawling SDKs.

tools.name: Diffbot
tools.description: Diffbot is a commercial web extraction and knowledge-graph service with APIs for articles, products, discussions, crawling, natural-language extraction, and entity search.

tools.name: Beautiful Soup
tools.description: Beautiful Soup is a Python library for navigating, searching, and modifying HTML or XML parse trees, commonly used as a low-level extraction component.

tools.name: Airbyte
tools.description: Airbyte is an open-source data-integration platform with a connector catalog, incremental synchronization, change-data capture, transformations, and managed cloud offerings.

tools.name: Meltano
tools.description: Meltano is an open-source data-integration platform that composes Singer taps and targets, schedules, state, environments, and transformations into reproducible pipelines.

tools.name: dlt
tools.description: dlt is an open-source Python library for loading data from APIs, databases, files, and generators into storage destinations with schemas, state, and incremental updates.

tools.name: Apache NiFi
tools.description: Apache NiFi is a visual dataflow system for routing, transforming, prioritizing, tracing, and governing data between heterogeneous sources and destinations.

tools.name: Apache Kafka Connect
tools.description: Apache Kafka Connect is Kafka's framework for scalable source and sink connectors, offset tracking, transformations, distributed workers, and streaming data movement.

tools.name: Fivetran
tools.description: Fivetran is a managed data-movement platform with source and destination connectors, automated schema handling, incremental sync, transformations, and governance features.

tools.name: VectorFlow
tools.description: VectorFlow is an open-source ingestion pipeline that accepts raw files, chunks and embeds their content, and writes vectors to supported databases through an API.

tools.name: NeMo Curator
tools.description: NeMo Curator is NVIDIA's scalable data-curation framework for document download, extraction, cleaning, deduplication, filtering, classification, synthetic data, and multimodal pipelines.

tools.name: Microsoft GraphRAG
tools.description: Microsoft GraphRAG is an open-source pipeline that extracts a knowledge graph, builds community summaries, and supports local, global, drift, and basic search over private text.

tools.name: LightRAG
tools.description: LightRAG is an open-source RAG framework that combines graph-based indexing with vector retrieval and supports multiple storage, model, and deployment backends.

tools.name: Neo4j GraphRAG for Python
tools.description: Neo4j GraphRAG for Python is an open-source package for knowledge-graph construction, vector and Cypher retrieval, external retrievers, reranking, and graph-grounded generation.

tools.name: Graphiti
tools.description: Graphiti is an open-source framework for building temporally aware knowledge graphs from conversations and business data and retrieving facts through hybrid graph search.

tools.name: HippoRAG
tools.description: HippoRAG is a research framework that builds knowledge graphs and applies personalized PageRank to support multi-hop, memory-inspired retrieval.

tools.name: KAG
tools.description: KAG is OpenSPG's knowledge-augmented generation framework for schema-guided graph construction, logical-form planning, hybrid reasoning, retrieval, and generation.

tools.name: nano-graphrag
tools.description: nano-graphrag is a compact GraphRAG implementation intended to expose and simplify graph extraction, clustering, storage, and query mechanics.

tools.name: TrustGraph
tools.description: TrustGraph is an open-source platform for knowledge extraction and Graph RAG with modular processing flows, graph and vector stores, provenance, and API access.

tools.name: Cognee
tools.description: Cognee is an open-source memory and data framework that turns documents and interactions into graph and vector representations, paired with hosted services.

tools.name: FalkorDB
tools.description: FalkorDB is an open-source graph database optimized for low-latency graph queries, with vector indexes, GraphRAG tooling, and commercial cloud and enterprise options.

tools.name: Memgraph
tools.description: Memgraph is an in-memory graph database with Cypher queries, streaming connectors, vector search, graph algorithms, and managed or enterprise offerings.

tools.name: NebulaGraph
tools.description: NebulaGraph is a distributed open-source graph database with nGQL queries, graph services, visualization tooling, and integrations for knowledge-graph and RAG applications.

tools.name: ArangoDB
tools.description: ArangoDB is a multi-model database for graphs, documents, key-values, full-text, and vector search, with GraphRAG integrations and managed services.

tools.name: ColPali
tools.description: ColPali is a visual document-retrieval approach and codebase that applies late interaction to page-image embeddings produced by vision-language models.

tools.name: ColQwen2
tools.description: ColQwen2 is a downloadable visual document-retrieval model based on Qwen2-VL and trained for ColBERT-style multi-vector page matching.

tools.name: Byaldi
tools.description: Byaldi is a Python wrapper for indexing and searching document images with ColPali-family multi-vector retrieval models.

tools.name: CLIP
tools.description: CLIP is OpenAI's downloadable contrastive image-text model and reference code for producing aligned visual and language representations used in cross-modal retrieval.

tools.name: SigLIP
tools.description: SigLIP is Google's downloadable image-text representation model family trained with a sigmoid loss for zero-shot classification and cross-modal similarity.

tools.name: ImageBind
tools.description: ImageBind is Meta's model and codebase for aligning image, text, audio, depth, thermal, and inertial data in one embedding space under model-specific terms.

tools.name: Jina CLIP
tools.description: Jina CLIP is Jina AI's downloadable multilingual text-image embedding model family for cross-modal search, retrieval, and ranking.

tools.name: Nomic Embed Vision
tools.description: Nomic Embed Vision is Nomic AI's downloadable image encoder aligned with Nomic Embed Text for shared-space multimodal retrieval.

tools.name: Voyage Multimodal Embeddings
tools.description: Voyage Multimodal Embeddings is a hosted model API that embeds interleaved text and images, including document screenshots, into a shared retrieval space.

tools.name: Twelve Labs Marengo
tools.description: Twelve Labs Marengo is a hosted video-embedding model and search API for retrieving moments by text, image, audio, and video queries.

tools.name: HyDE
tools.description: HyDE is the reference implementation of Hypothetical Document Embeddings, which generates a hypothetical answer document and embeds it to retrieve real passages without relevance labels.

tools.name: SPLADE
tools.description: SPLADE is Naver's learned sparse-retrieval implementation that expands queries and documents into weighted vocabulary terms compatible with inverted indexes.

tools.name: DPR
tools.description: DPR is Meta's Dense Passage Retrieval codebase for training dual encoders and retrieving passages with dense maximum-inner-product search.

tools.name: Contriever
tools.description: Contriever is Meta's unsupervised dense-retrieval model and training code for learning transferable query-passage representations without relevance labels.

tools.name: Self-RAG
tools.description: Self-RAG is a research framework in which a model adaptively retrieves passages and emits reflection tokens to critique relevance, support, and response quality.

tools.name: Corrective-RAG
tools.description: Corrective-RAG is the reference implementation of CRAG, which evaluates retrieved documents and can trigger corrective web retrieval before generation.

tools.name: Adaptive-RAG
tools.description: Adaptive-RAG is a research implementation that routes questions among no-retrieval, single-step, and iterative retrieval strategies according to predicted complexity.

tools.name: FLARE
tools.description: FLARE is the reference implementation of Forward-Looking Active Retrieval, which retrieves during generation when forthcoming sentence confidence is low.

tools.name: RAPTOR
tools.description: RAPTOR is a retrieval approach and implementation that recursively clusters and summarizes text to build a tree queried at multiple abstraction levels.

tools.name: RAFT
tools.description: RAFT is a training recipe and reference implementation for adapting models to answer from retrieved domain documents while distinguishing relevant context from distractors.

tools.name: Rankify
tools.description: Rankify is a unified information-retrieval toolkit that exposes retrieval, reranking, query expansion, dataset, and evaluation components behind common interfaces.

tools.name: Ragas
tools.description: Ragas is an open-source evaluation toolkit for RAG and other LLM applications with faithfulness, response relevance, context precision and recall, test generation, and experiment workflows.

tools.name: DeepEval RAG metrics
tools.description: DeepEval RAG metrics are open-source evaluators for answer relevancy, faithfulness, contextual precision, contextual recall, and contextual relevancy that run locally or in CI.

tools.name: DeepTeam
tools.description: DeepTeam is an open-source red-teaming framework for testing LLM and RAG applications against vulnerabilities and adversarial attacks, including prompt injection, data leakage, misinformation, and unsafe behavior.

tools.name: TruLens
tools.description: TruLens is an open-source evaluation and tracking library that instruments LLM applications and implements feedback functions including the RAG triad of context relevance, groundedness, and answer relevance.

tools.name: ARES
tools.description: ARES is Stanford's automated RAG evaluation framework using synthetic training data, lightweight judges, and prediction-powered inference to estimate context relevance, faithfulness, and answer relevance.

tools.name: RAGChecker
tools.description: RAGChecker is Amazon Science's fine-grained diagnostic framework that evaluates retriever and generator behavior through claim-level entailment and error categories.

tools.name: Arize Phoenix
tools.description: Arize Phoenix is an open-source observability and evaluation platform with tracing, datasets, experiments, retrieval analysis, and LLM-based evaluators for RAG applications.

tools.name: AutoRAG
tools.description: AutoRAG is an open-source optimization framework that evaluates combinations of parsing, chunking, retrieval, augmentation, reranking, and generation modules on a user's dataset.

tools.name: Tonic Validate
tools.description: Tonic Validate is an open-source RAG evaluation library for answer similarity, retrieval precision and recall, answer consistency, augmentation accuracy, and benchmark reporting.

tools.name: continuous-eval
tools.description: continuous-eval is an open-source framework for modular evaluation of retrieval, reranking, generation, classification, and agent pipelines with datasets and custom metrics.

tools.name: Giskard
tools.description: Giskard is an open-source testing library with a commercial platform for RAG evaluation, knowledge-base quality checks, hallucination testing, vulnerability scanning, and test generation.

tools.name: Patronus AI
tools.description: Patronus AI is a commercial evaluation and security platform with experiments, judge models, hallucination and RAG evaluators, red teaming, monitoring, and enterprise controls.

tools.name: Galileo
tools.description: Galileo is a commercial AI evaluation and observability platform with RAG quality metrics, retrieval and generation diagnostics, experiments, tracing, monitoring, and guardrails.

tools.name: LangSmith
tools.description: LangSmith is LangChain's commercial platform for tracing, datasets, offline and online evaluation, annotation, prompt management, experiments, and production monitoring across framework choices.

tools.name: Opik
tools.description: Opik is an open-source evaluation and observability platform from Comet with tracing, datasets, experiments, LLM judges, RAG metrics, prompt management, and a hosted service.

tools.name: Evidently
tools.description: Evidently is an open-source evaluation and monitoring library with test suites, reports, retrieval and generation descriptors, datasets, tracing integrations, and a commercial cloud.

tools.name: BEIR
tools.description: BEIR is a heterogeneous zero-shot information-retrieval benchmark spanning 18 datasets and multiple domains, with standardized loaders, retrieval baselines, and evaluation metrics.

tools.name: MTEB
tools.description: MTEB is a large multilingual benchmark and evaluation package for text embeddings across retrieval, reranking, classification, clustering, semantic similarity, and related tasks.

tools.name: CRAG
tools.description: CRAG is Meta's Comprehensive RAG Benchmark with thousands of questions, temporal and long-tail facts, mock web and knowledge-graph APIs, and end-to-end scoring.

tools.name: BRIGHT
tools.description: BRIGHT is a benchmark for reasoning-intensive retrieval across technical and everyday domains where identifying relevant documents requires substantial query reasoning.

tools.name: RAGBench
tools.description: RAGBench is a large explainable RAG dataset across multiple industry domains with retrieved contexts, responses, labels, and the associated TRACe evaluation framework.

tools.name: MTRAG
tools.description: MTRAG is IBM's human-generated benchmark for evaluating multi-turn retrieval-augmented generation across domains, conversation histories, retrieval, and grounded responses.

tools.name: MIRACL
tools.description: MIRACL is a multilingual information-retrieval benchmark with relevance judgments for queries and Wikipedia passages across 18 languages.

tools.name: LoTTE
tools.description: LoTTE is a long-tail topic-stratified retrieval benchmark with search and forum queries across five domains and pooled relevance judgments.

tools.name: KILT
tools.description: KILT is Meta's benchmark that grounds multiple knowledge-intensive language tasks in a shared Wikipedia snapshot and scores both retrieval provenance and task output.

tools.name: MS MARCO
tools.description: MS MARCO is Microsoft's large-scale passage and document ranking benchmark derived from real search queries with relevance labels and public leaderboard tasks.

tools.name: Natural Questions
tools.description: Natural Questions is Google's question-answering dataset of real search queries paired with Wikipedia pages and annotated long and short answers.

tools.name: HotpotQA
tools.description: HotpotQA is a multi-hop question-answering benchmark with supporting-fact annotations that tests retrieval and reasoning across multiple Wikipedia passages.

tools.name: ViDoRe
tools.description: ViDoRe is a benchmark and evaluation toolkit for visual document retrieval across page images, varied document domains, and multilingual queries.

tools.name: RAGTruth
tools.description: RAGTruth is a corpus of RAG responses with word-level hallucination annotations across question answering, data-to-text generation, and summarization.

tools.name: RGB
tools.description: RGB is a benchmark for RAG robustness across noise tolerance, negative rejection, information integration, and counterfactual conflict.

tools.name: Langfuse
tools.description: Langfuse is an open-source LLM engineering platform with self-hosting and cloud options for traces, sessions, prompt management, datasets, evaluations, metrics, and cost analysis.

tools.name: Helicone
tools.description: Helicone is an open-source AI gateway and observability platform with request logging, sessions, caching, routing, rate limits, experiments, evaluations, and a hosted service.

tools.name: OpenLLMetry
tools.description: OpenLLMetry is an OpenTelemetry-based set of instrumentations for capturing model, vector-database, framework, and agent spans and exporting them to compatible backends.

tools.name: OpenInference
tools.description: OpenInference is an open specification and instrumentation collection for representing LLM, retrieval, reranking, embedding, tool, and agent operations as OpenTelemetry traces.

tools.name: OpenLIT
tools.description: OpenLIT is an OpenTelemetry-native AI engineering platform with tracing, metrics, prompt management, evaluations, guardrails, cost tracking, and self-hosted or cloud deployment.

tools.name: LangWatch
tools.description: LangWatch is an open-source platform with hosted options for LLM traces, evaluations, dashboards, prompt optimization, and scenario-based agent simulation.

tools.name: Portkey
tools.description: Portkey is an open-source AI gateway paired with a commercial control plane for routing, fallbacks, caching, budgets, observability, guardrails, and provider access policies.

tools.name: Datadog LLM Observability
tools.description: Datadog LLM Observability is a commercial tracing and monitoring product for LLM and RAG applications with retrieval spans, quality signals, security scanning, cost, and latency analysis.

tools.name: LLM Guard
tools.description: LLM Guard is an open-source input and output scanning library for prompt injection, secrets, PII, toxicity, malicious URLs, relevance, factual consistency, and other risks.

tools.name: NeMo Guardrails
tools.description: NeMo Guardrails is NVIDIA's open-source toolkit for programmable dialog, retrieval, execution, and safety rails, including topical controls and groundedness checks.

tools.name: Guardrails AI
tools.description: Guardrails AI is an open-source validation framework with a hosted platform and validator hub for structured outputs, content checks, PII, provenance, and policy enforcement.

tools.name: Lakera Guard
tools.description: Lakera Guard is a commercial API for detecting prompt injection, jailbreaks, harmful content, and sensitive information in AI application inputs and outputs.

tools.name: garak
tools.description: garak is NVIDIA's open-source generative-AI vulnerability scanner with probes and detectors for prompt injection, data leakage, hallucination, toxicity, jailbreaks, and other failure modes.

tools.name: Canopy
tools.description: Canopy was Pinecone's open-source RAG framework and context engine; its GitHub repository is archived, so new systems should use maintained alternatives or lower-level Pinecone SDKs.

tools.name: Kùzu
tools.description: Kùzu was an embedded property-graph database with Cypher, vector search, and full-text search; its GitHub repository was archived in October 2025.

tools.name: llama-hub legacy repository
tools.description: llama-hub legacy repository was the original home of LlamaIndex data loaders; it was archived in March 2024 after integrations moved to maintained package repositories.
